# Replays the REL (relative/pegged-to-primary) rest/cancel lifecycle (ORD-001
# relative variant) observed on 2026-06-10 against live paper Gateway: a REL
# BUY 100 AAPL with a far-below-market price cap 14.61 (delayed-quote anchor
# 292.17 / 20) and no client offset was accepted; the Gateway's open_order
# echo assigned offset 0.01 in aux_price. The order moved PreSubmitted (three
# echoes) to Submitted, the API cancel produced order_status Cancelled plus
# the code-202 notice, and the final safety global cancel drew real code-161
# replies: one for the previous scenario's order 340 (still bound to this
# client id on the Gateway) and one for order 342. Both surface as session
# notices; order 342's Cancelled status owns the clean handle close.
# Sanitized: account identifiers redacted to the DU9000001 redaction token,
# perm ids -> 900340/900342 (including inside the code-161 message texts),
# order ref -> ibkrgo-sanitized-20260610T195833Z-001. Trimmed: farm-status
# 2104/2107/2158, the driver's startup safety global cancel and its code-161
# replies for the previous scenario's orders, and the driver's delayed-quote
# anchor exchange (market-data-type toggles, the req 1/2 tick stream, and the
# code-10089 entitlement notice).
